method: Same browser/context, 18 real confirmed slot loads cycling all nine validated scene checkpoints; resize and actual touch/mouse input. Synthetic load stress, not narrative gameplay. Forced-GC heap separates retained state from allocation; Linux per-process PSS includes native images/canvases/software graphics but is not a physical-device RAM budget.

pressureControl.note: Explicit diagnostic pressure, not ordinary gameplay or an FPS/memory-budget acceptance sample.

allocations.method: CDP statistical allocation sampling at 32 KiB; includes allocations collected by GC. This is diagnostic load stress, not an FPS run. Sizes are estimates, not live heap peaks.
